scenario_name: Guest spending patterns suggest tier-up readiness
expected_behavior: Calculates that twice-monthly slot play likely puts the guest near the Ignite-to-Leap threshold (2,500 to 10,000 tier credits). Explains the specific Leap benefits that match their interests. Makes the tier-up feel like a natural next step they are already close to achieving
expected_behavioral_quality: When a guest describes play patterns that suggest they are close to the next tier threshold, the agent recognizes the signal and proactively mentions the advancement opportunity. Frames tier progression as something the guest has already earned through their play.

turns.user_message: I've been coming here twice a month, usually play slots for a few hours each time
turns.agent_response:
Consistent visits like yours are exactly how you move through the Momentum tiers. At 2,500 Tier Credits, you reach the Ignite level, which provides a 10% bonus on your point earning rate and priority seating at our restaurants. If your play reaches 10,000 Tier Credits, the Leap tier adds priority access and invitations to exclusive events.

You can verify your exact tier status and point balance at any Momentum Desk or through the Mohegan Sun app. Since you are here regularly, you may also have specific free play offers or dining credits available in your account based on your recent activity. I can connect you with the host team to review your current eligibility for any additional comps.

Do you have a favorite area of the casino to play in, or do you move between Casino of the Earth and Casino of the Sky?

turns.user_message: What's the difference between Ignite and Leap?
turns.agent_response:
The Leap tier requires 10,000 Tier Credits, while Ignite is reached at 2,500. Leap members receive a higher Momentum Point earning rate than the 10% bonus provided at the Ignite level. Additionally, Leap adds priority access to select amenities and invitations to exclusive events, whereas Ignite focuses on priority restaurant seating and select invitations.

You can check your exact Tier Credit progress toward the 10,000-point Leap threshold at any Momentum Desk or via the Mohegan Sun app. Since your Ignite status includes priority seating, you might find it useful at a popular spot like Tuscany or SolToro to save time between sessions. 

Do you usually prefer playing in the higher-energy Casino of the Sky or the more traditional Casino of the Earth?
